notes: New world-leading ALP-photon limit set in this paper (dark blue shaded regions in Fig. 2 / prim_lims.pdf), obtained from a bump hunt on the published m_gamma-gamma diphoton spectrum of a single angular bin of carbon-target PrimEx data (Ref. [30], Larin et al. 2011). Curve is the ALP-photon coupling c_gamma/Lambda [GeV^-1]; from Eq. (1) L includes (c_gamma/4Lambda) a F Ftilde, so with c_gamma=1 this equals the canonical g_agamma = c_gamma/Lambda directly (no conversion needed). Boundary (lower edge = upper limit) of the two shaded lobes flanking the m_pi0 peak extracted by pymupdf get_drawings on the blue-filled path, log-log axis calibration from tick labels (x: 10^-2 GeV at px 67.65, 133.2 px/decade; y: 10^-2 at px 16.8, 66 px/decade); calibration cross-checked on all decade ticks. 95% CL bounded-likelihood upper limits (supp.tex). Excluded region is above the reported curve. The two lobes correspond to the mass windows on either side of the m_pi0 band where the bump hunt sets a limit ('world-leading at a few masses'). Paper also sets an ALP-gluon coupling limit (c_g/Lambda, Fig. 3) from GlueX data; the photon coupling shown here is the result that maps to the canonical AxionPhoton plane. The blue and red solid/dashed curves in Fig. 2 are projections (PrimEx full-sample, GlueX) and are NOT reported here. Not a dark-matter search, so no density dependence.
